name: firewall-probe
cmd: mkdir -p /tmp/prof; timeout -s KILL 100 bun --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-dir=/tmp/prof research/protocols/ic3syn/probe.ts firewall 20000; s=$?; ls /tmp/prof; python3 research/protocols/engine/profwin.py /tmp/prof/*.cpuprofile 0 400 50; exit $s
